title: Echoes and Reverberation
summary: Reflection of sound, the 17.2 m rule for echoes, measuring distance, and designing halls that sound good.
objectives: I can explain what an echo is and when it can be heard.
I can calculate distances using echo times.
I can explain reverberation and how it is reduced.
misconceptions: The echo time gives the distance to the wall directly (forgetting to halve).
